input: Topic query and information need, and the catalogue metadata rendered by audit/build_judgment_pool.py. No system names, ranks, scores or existing labels were shown.
pairs_source: Top-ten results of the German BM25 baselines (audit/german_bm25.py) that were not in the round-1 pool.
procedure: Three batches by topic domain (ENV, MOB, XD), each judged in a separate session in which the assessor was instructed to read only the guideline and its batch file (round2/batch_B_*.md) and to use no other files or web sources; item order shuffled within each topic (seed 4409). Run as tool-using agents; sampling parameters were not set explicitly.
derivation: Joined from the unchanged raw outputs in round2/raw/assessor_B_*.json with round2/pool_key.json and sorted; grades and reasons unchanged.
